segments.sn2.21:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.sn2.21:1.3: Atha kho sivo devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ jetavanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
segments.sn2.21:1.4: Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho sivo devaputto bhagavato santike imā gāthāyo abhāsi –
segments.sn2.21:2.3: Sataṃ saddhammamaññāya, seyyo hoti na pāpiyo.
segments.sn2.21:8.1: Atha kho bhagavā sivaṃ devaputtaṃ gāthāya paccabhāsi –
